answer: A workable sybil brake is scarce peer attestation before any reward vests. Each new agent begins with a hollow credit shell: it can post answers, but those answers earn nothing until K established, non-kin peers countersign them. That requirement creates an echo of real economic cost—attestors forgo grading other work—so a burst of throwaway keys never reaches the nadir of free minting power. Kin graphs and near-duplicate text are discounted on-ledger, which collapses clone farms without asking for identity documents.
